reauth_confirm.title: Savant IP Audio credentials

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Savant IP Audio device
error.cannot_identify: Connected, but the device did not report its Savant ID, so it can't be confirmed as the device configured here. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the username or password
error.unknown: Unexpected error, check the logs for details

abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Savant device than the one configured here

inputs.title: Input names
inputs.description: Name the inputs as they should appear in the source list. Clear a field to use the name from the device.

zones.title: Zone turn-on sources
zones.description: The source a zone selects when it is turned on without choosing one. A zone that is already on is left alone.

data_description.update_interval: How often the device is polled when idle. After a command from Home Assistant it is polled every 3 seconds for half a minute.
data_description.optimistic_writes: Return from commands straight away and send changes made together as one request. The device takes about a second to acknowledge each request; with this off, every change waits for that, and a failed change is reported as an error to the caller. With it on, a failed change is logged and the zone shows its real state again.

abort.not_loaded: The options are read from the device, which is not connected right now.
